score_definition.D: national demand index = 0.7*predicted within-cohort reach percentile + 0.3*predicted within-cohort audience-score percentile
score_definition.Fit: 0.75*sum_q pi_q(title)*z[state,q] over topical Trends anchors + 0.25*channel (manga/movie/series) interest; pi=softmax(cos(title,anchor)/tau) in learned taste space
score_definition.B_state: mean z of generic anime queries (state's baseline anime propensity)
score_definition.weights_note: weights are expert priors, NOT fitted: no India sales/viewership ground truth exists in the dataset. Expose as sliders.

audience_survey.note: 706 India respondents' favorite genre + most-watched/top-3 titles feed two new, auditable demand features (ind_genre_affinity, ind_title_buzz) -- validated with the same group-permutation importance and exact Shapley attribution as every other factor, so a weak or synthetic signal shows up as near-zero importance rather than being hidden. This is independent of the Trends layer, which stays the only STATE-level signal.

limitations: No India box-office, streaming or merchandise ground truth exists in the data: demand is learned from GLOBAL fan engagement and re-weighted for India via Trends. Scores are relative rankings, not revenue forecasts.
Age demographics are approximated by Japanese target-demographic tags (shounen/seinen/...), not measured Indian age data.
Region/language weights (w_demand, w_fit, w_base) are expert priors; the bridge-validity statistic tells you how far to trust the taste-to-Trends mapping.
State populations are approximate constants in jpscore.STATE_META.

ind_title_buzz matches on exact title string, so it is 0 for almost every current-season title (the India survey's 'most-watched' entries skew toward long-running classics); it mainly activates when scoring a new sequel/spin-off of an already-famous franchise. ind_genre_affinity is the feature that generalises across the whole catalog.

source_audit.role: demand training targets + the titles being scored
India-specific genre affinity + per-title buzz features
source_audit.reliability: Low-Medium (sequential placeholder IDs suggest a simulated/synthetic sample, not a verified survey)

source_audit.role: cross-check context only, not a model feature
